aggregate.name: Aggregate
aggregate.description: GROUP BY with aggregates, one per line: name = count(), total = sum(pop).

aggregate-within.name: Aggregate Within
aggregate-within.description: Each polygon with a count, sum, mean, min or max of the points inside it, as a new column `<operation>_<column>` (0 for none).

along.name: Along
along.description: The point a distance along each line, as turf.along; past the end is the end. Lines only.

arc.name: Arc Layer
arc.description: An arc per row between two positions.

area.name: Area
area.description: A column with each feature’s area on the spheroid, as turf.area; 0 for points and lines.

attribute.name: Attribute Create
attribute.description: Create or overwrite one attribute from an expression.

bezier-curve.name: Bezier Curve
bezier-curve.description: A number from a curve: the curve’s height at a factor from 0 to 1.

bitmap.name: Bitmap Layer
bitmap.description: Render a raster image at specified boundaries

bitmap-overlay-widget.name: Bitmap Overlay
bitmap-overlay-widget.description: Display a bitmap image as a screen-space overlay

brightness-contrast.name: Brightness / Contrast
brightness-contrast.description: Adjust brightness and contrast of a layer

brushable-histogram.name: Brushable Histogram
brushable-histogram.description: Keep rows whose column lies in a brushed range, drawn over the column's histogram in the parameter pane. Drag the brush, or keyframe its ends to animate it. Bins is a table of the histogram.

brushing.name: Brushing
brushing.description: Show only objects near the pointer

buffer.name: Buffer
buffer.description: Each feature grown by a distance on the ground (shrunk, for a negative one), as turf.buffer.

cells.name: Grid Cells
cells.description: Rows with a grid cell id (H3, S2, A5, geohash or quadkey) as polygon features of their cells, keeping their columns; a column of H3 id lists draws each list’s merged outline. What deck’s cell layers draw. Runs in the engine.

centroid.name: Centroid
centroid.description: Each feature as a point at its center of mass, keeping its properties. turf.centroid averages a feature's vertices instead; the two differ for uneven shapes.

ChartOp.name: Chart
ChartOp.description: Create charts using Observable Plot (bar, histogram, scatter)

choropleth.name: Choropleth Layer
choropleth.description: Rows joined onto boundaries (as Choropleth Join does) and filled by a color ramp over a column, its domain the column's minimum to maximum; a boundary with no value is gray.

choropleth-join.name: Choropleth Join
choropleth-join.description: Rows joined onto boundaries by a key: US states, world countries or Canadian provinces. A row per boundary with its geometry, its name and codes (`name`, `abbrev`, `fips`, `iso2`, `iso3`) and the matching row's columns; a boundary no row matches keeps only its own. The key's kind (a name, an abbreviation, a FIPS or ISO code) is detected from the values when left on Auto. Runs in the engine; the boundaries are fetched once.

clip.name: Clip
clip.description: Each feature cut by a mask (the union of its features): the part inside, as turf.intersect and a clip do, or the part outside, as turf.difference does. Features left with nothing are dropped. turf takes the first feature of each side; this cuts every feature by the whole mask.

clip-extension.name: Clip Extension
clip-extension.description: Clip layers by a rectangular bounds

cluster.name: Cluster
cluster.description: Points labeled with a `cluster` number by k-means (turf.clustersKmeans) or by density (turf.clustersDbscan, with `dbscan` noise/core/edge). Runs turf in the engine.

code.name: Code
code.description: Rows made by JavaScript: `d` is the input's rows as objects (an empty array with nothing wired), or a JSON file parsed whole when a URL is set, and the body returns an array of rows or GeoJSON. d3, turf and utils are in scope. It runs when its input changes, in the engine, and its rows become a DuckDB table every later node plans over; for per-row values use a JS Function instead.

CodeOp.name: Code
CodeOp.description: Run custom JavaScript code to transform your data. Available variables: `data` (all input data), `d` (first element), `op()` (access other operators), `sequenceTime` (timeline position), `frame` (current frame), `totalFrames`, `sequence` (timeline metadata). Includes d3, turf, and other utilities. Use `this` to store state between executions.

collision-filter.name: Collision Filter
collision-filter.description: Hide overlapping objects, keeping the higher priority one

color.name: Color
color.description: A color other parameters reference, so several layers can share one.

color-ramp.name: Color Ramp
color-ramp.description: Map a value through a color ramp into an RGB attribute.

column.name: Column Layer
column.description: An extruded column per row: bars on a map.

comment.name: Comment
comment.description: A note that explains the nodes beside it. Double-click it to edit its text. Nothing connects to it, and it lowers to nothing.

contour.name: Contour Layer
contour.description: Rows binned into a grid of a cell size in meters, drawn as iso-lines at thresholds or bands between them.

convex-hull.name: Convex Hull
convex-hull.description: One polygon enclosing every feature, as turf.convex.

CustomMapLibreLayerOp.name: CustomMapLibreLayer
CustomMapLibreLayerOp.description: Define a custom MapLibre GL layer with WebGL rendering. The code must return an object with onAdd, render, and onRemove methods. Access parameters via `params` object and map instance via `map`.

deck.name: Deck
deck.description: The map: layers bottom to top, the basemap, and the camera. Camera fields are props, so a keyframed fly-through costs no queries.

DirectionsOp.name: Directions
DirectionsOp.description: Get driving, traffic-aware driving, or transit directions between points

dissolve.name: Dissolve
dissolve.description: Polygons merged: all of them, or those sharing a value of a column (turf.dissolve, turf.union). With separate parts on, each connected piece is its own row.

distance.name: Distance
distance.description: Great-circle distance in km between two lng/lat points (haversine).

explode.name: Explode
explode.description: Each multi-part feature as one row per part (turf.flatten), or every feature as one point row per vertex (turf.explode). Properties are copied to every row.

expression.name: Expression
expression.description: A number from an expression over a, b, T (seconds), F (frame) and ch() references.

extent.name: Extent
extent.description: The minimum and maximum of an expression over the rows that reach it, computed in SQL. Wire min or max into another node's parameter, e.g. a Map Range's In max.

features.name: Features
features.description: GeoJSON written into the node (a FeatureCollection, a Feature or a bare geometry) or WKT, as a table of features. What a drawing tool writes.

file.name: File
file.description: Read a CSV, JSON or Parquet file by URL. The relation is memoized: it is fetched once.

fill-style.name: Fill Style
fill-style.description: Fill polygons with a pattern from an atlas

filter.name: Filter
filter.description: Keep rows matching a condition. The planner puts it in SQL when that removes real volume.

fit-bounds.name: Fit Bounds
fit-bounds.description: The camera that fits rows into the render surface: wire its view state into the deck, or its longitude, latitude and zoom into a View State. The bounds are computed in DuckDB.

fps-widget.name: FPS Widget
fps-widget.description: Display frames per second (FPS) and rendering stats widget

generate.name: Generate
generate.description: N rows numbered 0…N−1. Cross-join it to give every row N steps.

geo-distance.name: Distance to Geometry
geo-distance.description: Distance from each row's point to a line, polygon or set of points: zero inside a polygon.

geo-grid.name: Grid Features
geo-grid.description: Hexagons, squares or points of one cell size covering a bounding box, as turf.hexGrid, squareGrid and pointGrid make them. Join features to it to bin them.

GeocoderOp.name: Geocoder
GeocoderOp.description: Get the location of a query string

geojson.name: GeoJSON
geojson.description: A GeoJSON file, or any vector file DuckDB spatial reads (shapefile, GeoPackage…), as rows: `features` has one row per feature with its geometry; polygons, lines and points have one row per vertex, ready for a layer; `all` has every vertex row with a `kind` column. Wire a table with a `geom` column into `in` to read its geometry instead of a file.

grid.name: Grid Bin
grid.description: Count rows per square cell and emit one row per cell at its center (P), with n and the weight sum w.

grid-cell.name: Grid Cell Layer
grid-cell.description: A square column per row, of a cell size in meters, raised by a per-row elevation.

grid-layer.name: Grid Layer
grid-layer.description: Rows binned into square cells, colored and raised by per-row weights deck sums per bin.

heatmap.name: Heatmap Layer
heatmap.description: A density surface of the rows' positions, weighted per row.

hexagon.name: Hexagon Layer
hexagon.description: Rows binned into hexagons, colored and raised by per-row weights deck sums per bin.

hue-saturation.name: Hue / Saturation
hue-saturation.description: Adjust hue and saturation of a layer

icon.name: Icon Layer
icon.description: An icon per row from an atlas image: a string column names each row’s icon in the mapping.

inside.name: Inside / Outside
inside.description: Features split by whether they touch any feature of a second table (a point inside a polygon, on its edge included, as turf.booleanPointInPolygon): `inside` and `outside`.

interpolate.name: Interpolate
interpolate.description: A grid of points valued by inverse-distance weighting of a column of the input points, as turf.interpolate. Runs turf in the engine.

isolines.name: Isolines
isolines.description: Contour lines through a grid of points at each break value of a column, as turf.isolines (the input must be a point grid, such as Interpolate makes). Runs turf in the engine.

join.name: Join
join.description: Match rows of two tables on key columns. Right-hand columns get the prefix.

js-function.name: JS Function
js-function.description: A JavaScript function any expression can call by name, run by DuckDB per row. For logic the expression language has no words for; it returns a number, or an array of `width` numbers. Prefer an expression where one will do: DuckDB runs JS some 20 times slower than SQL.

layer-props.name: Layer Props
layer-props.description: Props added to a layer: operation "mask" for a mask layer, beforeId to draw under a MapLibre layer, or any others as JSON.

legend-widget.name: Legend Widget
legend-widget.description: Display a color scale legend overlay on the visualization

length.name: Length
length.description: A column with each feature’s length on the spheroid (a polygon’s perimeter), as turf.length.

line.name: Line Layer
line.description: A straight segment per row between two positions.

line-slice.name: Line Slice
line-slice.description: The part of each line between two distances from its start, as turf.lineSliceAlong. Lines only.

line-to-polygon.name: Line to Polygon
line-to-polygon.description: Each line as the polygon it outlines, closed if it is open, as turf.lineToPolygon. Other features pass through.

map-range.name: Map Range
map-range.description: Rescale a value from one range to another, linearly, on a log scale or a square root.

map-style.name: Map Style
map-style.description: A basemap style with your changes: layers hidden or recolored, from the style editor. Wire it into the deck's map style.

mask-3d-extension.name: Mask 3D Extension
mask-3d-extension.description: Show only a sphere around a lng/lat/alt (meters) of a Tile3DLayer, fading to white at the edge

mask-extension.name: Mask Extension
mask-extension.description: Show/hide layer objects by a geofence

merge.name: Merge
merge.description: One object from several, later ones winning, as Object.assign does: view states, layer props.

mesh.name: Simple Mesh Layer
mesh.description: A 3D model per row, positioned, oriented (pitch, yaw, roll in degrees), scaled and colored by channels.

mouse.name: Mouse
mouse.description: The pointer over the map, in pixels from its top left. Wire x or y into a parameter; expressions can read MX and MY too.

nearest.name: Nearest
nearest.description: The feature nearest a point, with its distance in kilometers in `distanceToPoint`, as turf.nearestPoint.

number.name: Number
number.description: A constant, a slider, or a keyframed value. Wire it into any parameter.

overpass.name: Overpass
overpass.description: OpenStreetMap features an Overpass QL query finds, as a table of features: tagged nodes as points, ways as lines or polygons, multipolygon relations. `{{bbox}}` in the query is the bounds as south,west,north,east. The engine fetches once per query; edit it to fetch again.

path.name: Path Layer
path.description: A path per row when Position reads a list of positions or a geometry; otherwise rows are vertices, grouped into paths by an id column and ordered by another.

pmtiles.name: PMTiles
pmtiles.description: Load a PMTiles archive as a MapLibre vector or raster source

point.name: Point
point.description: One point feature at a longitude and latitude, which numbers can drive.

point-cloud.name: Point Cloud Layer
point-cloud.description: A lit point per row, sized in pixels or meters.

polygon.name: Polygon Layer
polygon.description: A polygon per row when Position reads a geometry (holes and multi-polygons included); otherwise rows are vertices, grouped into polygons by an id, into rings by another (the first ring is the outline, the rest are holes), ordered by a third.

polygon-to-line.name: Polygon to Line
polygon-to-line.description: Each polygon as its outline, holes included, as turf.polygonToLine. Other features pass through.

position.name: Point Position
position.description: Build the position attribute P from longitude, latitude and altitude.

ramp.name: Ramp
ramp.description: A number from stops: the value at a position, between stops linearly, smoothly (monotone) or held.

range.name: Range Filter
range.description: Keep rows whose column lies between two values.

raster-tiles.name: Raster Tile Layer
raster-tiles.description: Render a raster tile layer on the map

rectangle.name: Rectangle
rectangle.description: One rectangle feature of a width and height on the ground, centered on a point.

region.name: Region Filter
region.description: Keep rows inside, outside or near a polygon. Runs in SQL, on the GPU or the CPU, wherever the planner puts it.

reproject.name: Reproject
reproject.description: Coordinates from one CRS to another, as PROJ names them (EPSG:4326 is lng/lat).

scale-widget.name: Scale Widget
scale-widget.description: Display a map distance scale widget

scenegraph.name: Scenegraph Layer
scenegraph.description: A 3D model per row, positioned, oriented (pitch, yaw, roll in degrees), scaled and colored by channels.

screen-grid.name: Screen Grid Layer
screen-grid.description: Rows binned into square cells of a size on screen, colored by their summed or averaged weight.

screenshot-widget.name: Screenshot Widget
screenshot-widget.description: Download current frame as PNG widget

simplify.name: Simplify
simplify.description: Fewer vertices: Douglas–Peucker with a tolerance in degrees, as turf.simplify.

smooth-lines.name: Smooth Lines
smooth-lines.description: Lines with their corners rounded: a moving average of each vertex and its neighbors (gaussian or boxcar), or a spline through the vertices (Catmull–Rom, cardinal, basis, natural, monotone, or a fixed turn radius). Other features pass through. Runs in the engine.

sort.name: Sort
sort.description: Order rows by a column; with a limit, keep the top N.

spatial-join.name: Spatial Join
spatial-join.description: Each feature with the columns of a feature of the other table it intersects, lies within, or contains, as Noodles' spatial join: the first match, and a same-named column takes the match's value. Features with no match keep their own columns and nulls.

sql.name: DuckDB SQL
sql.description: Any SELECT. {{input0}}…{{input2}} name the connected tables; other {{name}} are parameters.

subnet.name: Subnetwork
subnet.description: A network inside a node. Double-click to enter. Promote parameters to control the inside from here.

subnet-input.name: Subnet Input
subnet-input.description: Inside a subnet: what is connected to the subnet's input.

subnet-output.name: Subnet Output
subnet-output.description: Inside a subnet: what the subnet outputs.

switch.name: Switch
switch.description: Pass one of several layers through, chosen by index. A change re-plans, and the memo keeps every layer it is not showing, so switching back costs at most that layer's query.

table.name: Table
table.description: Rows you type in, kept in the document: a table the engine loads once per edit.

terrain.name: Terrain Layer
terrain.description: Render a terrain mesh from heightmap tiles

terrain-extension.name: Terrain Extension
terrain-extension.description: Render a terrain layer on the map

text.name: Text Layer
text.description: A label per row from a string column.

tile-3d.name: Tile 3D Layer
tile-3d.description: Render 3D tiles on the map (Google, Cesium, or a custom tileset URL)

TileLayerOp.name: TileLayer
TileLayerOp.description: Render data organized in a tiled format (generic tile layer)

time.name: Time
time.description: Timeline seconds × speed + offset. The clock that drives an animation.

time-series.name: Time Series
time-series.description: Each path's place at one time, interpolated between the two vertices around it, holding the first and last vertex outside the path's span. Rows are either vertices (grouped by a path id) or whole paths (a list of positions and a list of timestamps per row). The time is a query parameter: moving it re-runs only the sampling query.

tin.name: TIN
tin.description: Triangles joining the input points (Delaunay), as turf.tin; with a column, each triangle has its corners’ values as a, b and c. Runs turf in the engine.

transform.name: Transform
transform.description: Each feature rotated (degrees clockwise), scaled about its centroid or bounding-box center, then moved a distance along a compass bearing, as turf.transformRotate, transformScale and transformTranslate.

trips.name: Trips Layer
trips.description: Animated trails: a trip per row when Position reads a list of positions and Timestamp a list of times; otherwise vertex rows with a timestamp each. Current time is a deck prop, so playing costs no queries.

union.name: Union
union.description: All rows of every input, columns matched by name.

unnest.name: Unnest
unnest.description: List columns to rows, in lockstep. Numbers each source row and each position, which is what a path layer groups and orders by.

view-state.name: View State
view-state.description: A camera: longitude, latitude, zoom, pitch and bearing, which numbers can drive.

voronoi.name: Voronoi
voronoi.description: One cell per point, the area nearer it than any other, clipped to the points' bounding box and carrying the point's properties, as turf.voronoi.

wrangle.name: Attribute Wrangle
wrangle.description: A VEX-style body: @name = expr; var t = expr; fn f(x) = expr;. Each statement is placed on its own.

xyz-tiles.name: XYZ Tiles
xyz-tiles.description: Configure a raster XYZ tile source from a URL template ({z}/{x}/{y})
